name: Jósvafő (Hungary)
description: A vertical pale blue banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Jósvafő: a red and blue shield with a figure and ears of grain, with a white bird crest, above a scroll inscribed JÓSVAFŐ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Jósvafő arms with crest and scroll
